final_review.suggestions: 1. Add a terminal check (os.isatty) at the very start of monitor.py, before any curses import, exiting gracefully if no TTY is present. 2. Replace the blocking search loop with a non-blocking state machine inside the main curses loop: on '/' toggle search_active, collect printable characters and backspace, and call process search/clear methods to update the filtered list immediately. 3. Ensure MAX_HISTORY = max(1, int(60 / max(interval, 0.1))) to prevent division by zero. 4. Remove all unused imports and variables (signal, struct, math, duplicate os, unused cpu_delta, search_mode variable).
